verdict.rationale: ReelMimic uses AI to analyze the user's own reference video, breaking it down into shot count, shot lengths, BPM, transitions, colors, framing and camera moves. It then proposes a storyboard, characters, assets and style frames that the user refines in chat, and writes up a new-style proposal when the reference doesn't match a known style. Missing for 10: insights beyond analysis of the single reference video (e.g. across projects or output performance), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the breakdown's quality.
